dose_rate.label: Radiation dose rate
dose_rate.what: How much radiation your body is absorbing per day.
dose_rate.space: Outside Earth's magnetic field, crews are exposed to cosmic rays all the time and to sudden bursts of particles during solar storms.
dose_rate.how: Read automatically from the cabin dosimeter.

heart_rate.label: Resting heart rate
heart_rate.what: How many times your heart beats per minute while you are at rest.
heart_rate.space: In low gravity, body fluid shifts toward the head and the heart and blood vessels gradually lose conditioning, so a rising resting rate is worth watching.
heart_rate.how: Read from your wrist sensor while you are still.

systolic_bp.label: Blood pressure
systolic_bp.what: The pressure in your arteries each time your heart beats (the upper number).
systolic_bp.space: Fluid shifts and changes to the blood vessels in spaceflight can move blood pressure up or down.
systolic_bp.how: Use the arm cuff after sitting still for five minutes, then enter the upper number.

body_temp.label: Body temperature
body_temp.what: Your core temperature. A fever usually means your body is fighting an infection.
body_temp.space: Spaceflight changes how the immune system works, and in a closed cabin an infection can spread to the whole crew.
body_temp.how: Use the thermometer from the medical kit and enter the reading.

blood_sugar.label: Blood sugar
blood_sugar.what: The amount of glucose in your blood, your body's main fuel.
blood_sugar.space: Diet, stress and reduced activity on a mission can all affect how well the body controls blood sugar.
blood_sugar.how: Use the finger-prick meter from the medical kit and enter the reading in mg/dL.

sleep_hours.label: Sleep
sleep_hours.what: How many hours you slept last night.
sleep_hours.space: Noise, workload and the lack of a normal day and night make sleep shorter on missions, which affects mood, attention and safety.
sleep_hours.how: Read from your wrist sensor, or enter it in the daily check-in.

mood.label: Mood
mood.what: Your own rating of how you feel today, from 1 (very low) to 5 (very good).
mood.space: Isolation, confinement and distance from home build up over a long mission. A slow slide over days matters more than one bad day.
mood.how: Rate it in the daily check-in.

exercise_pct.label: Exercise completed
exercise_pct.what: How much of your prescribed exercise plan you have completed this week.
exercise_pct.space: Without the load of gravity, bones lose mineral and muscles shrink. Regular resistance and cardio exercise is the main protection.
exercise_pct.how: Logged automatically by the exercise equipment.
